newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus fuel prices go up by maximum 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus fuel prices go up by maximum 15 pct.

text.p: Price increases of up to 15 percent for petrol and diesel fuel will come into effect in Cyprus on Friday, the commerce and industry ministry announced.
Three types of petrol - super, unleaded and extra - are going up by three percent, while diesel and lighting fuel will cost 14.8 percent more.

The price changes were submitted to parliament on Thursday afternoon. In a note accompanying the legislation the commerce ministry said increases were in line with a rise in the price of crude on international markets.

Fuel prices are reviewed by the government twice a year. Fuel importers recently lobbied the authorities, demanding a review of prices to counter losses they said they sustained from high international rates.
